surface.name: final_normalized_patch_tokens_pre_projection
surface.description: Final visual Transformer block, native final normalization, CLS removed, all patch tokens retained, visual retrieval projection not applied.

gap_linear.description: Mean over the exact patch-token surface followed by one linear classifier.

gap_mlp.description: Mean over the exact patch-token surface followed by a two-layer GELU MLP; hidden width is selected to match the Transformer readout parameter count.

transformer.description: Low-rank projector, one learned CLS token, two pre-norm Transformer encoder layers, and a linear classifier.
transformer.positional_encoding: none; tokenizer token values already contain native visual positional information
